devon_support: Hey team, Customer ACME-238 reports an invoice that's $12.34 higher than their dashboard for Feb 28. They attached invoice PDF and say dashboard shows $1,024.11 but invoice charged $1,036.45. They want a refund path and explanation.
raj_engineer: Thanks, can you paste the invoice id and account id? Also was this customer using embeddings or gen endpoints that day?
devon_support: Invoice ID INV-2024-0228-ACME, account acme-238. They used embeddings heavily between 23:30-00:30 PST that night. No other anomalies reported.
anna_finance: Noted. I'll provisionally approve a small provisional credit while we investigate. Need ledger extract and the day's metering aggregation windows to confirm root cause for revrec note.
billing_bot: Ledger extract for acme-238 for 2024-02-28 attached (csv link). Total tokens per event = 1,234,567. Invoice total USD = 1036.45 (conversion at 2024-02-29 02:00 UTC rate).
sam_ops: Quick check: our dashboard rolls up usage per customer in their local timezone (account tz = America/Los_Angeles) and rounds per-day metrics to 2 decimals before display. Invoice uses UTC billing window and applies currency conversion at invoice generation time with per-event rounding to cents. That mismatch can create a delta.
raj_engineer: I pulled the metering aggregation SQL; snippet:
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS bill_day, sum(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE account_id='acme-238' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2024-02-28' AND '2024-03-01' GROUP BY 1;
```
That aggregates in UTC. Dashboard uses `timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'`. Here the heavy embedding window straddles midnight PST so some tokens land on 2024-02-28 in dashboard but 2024-02-29 in invoice (UTC).
devon_support: So customer saw lower number on dashboard because some tokens were attributed to different calendar day? They'll argue numbers should match.
anna_finance: For the refund path: propose provisional credit of $12.34 today to match invoice difference, tag revrec note: "FT-2024-987: provisional credit for timezone + conversion rounding delta; will reconcile on next statement if merchant dispute resolved." Can we confirm exact cents delta mapping?
sam_ops: I computed per-event rounding delta: invoice-level conversion + per-event cent rounding = $12.34 gap. I can attach a diff CSV showing each event rounding contribution.
raj_engineer: Filing an engineering follow-up to make the dashboard show "invoice view" (align aggregation window and conversion rates) and add a tooltip explaining rounding differences. Creating ticket: INF-3421.
anna_finance: I'll create the accounting entry and set revrec tag FT-2024-987. Also need approval chain sign-off from legal for customer-facing wording.
devon_support: Customer notified about provisional credit and told them we expect full reconciliation by next invoice; they replied :thumbsup: and asked for a short explanation to send internally.
sam_ops: Suggested explanation: "Dashboard shows local-day rollups and rounds displayed totals; invoices use UTC billing windows and apply currency conversion with per-event rounding at invoice time. Small cents differences can occur when usage straddles timezone boundaries."
anna_finance: I'll log the provisional credit transaction id and add to case. Posting finance note: RevRecCode=FT-2024-987; ProvisionalCreditID=PC-55421; Amount=12.34 USD.
devon_support: Thanks everyone. I'll close the support case once finance confirms credit applied and the customer ack.
raj_engineer: INF-3421 assigned to @raj_engineer, priority P2, ETA end-of-sprint for dashboard invoice-view toggle.
sam_ops: Leaving audit note: ops-aggregate-query adjusted with explicit timezone param to avoid ambiguity.
anna_finance: Filing final ticket to reconcile on Mar 31 run.
devon_support: closing loop — customer confirmed credit applied and said they'll re-open if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
